title: CourseAsCode Text and Media Area (Label) Activity
description: Schema for TMA_*.yaml Text and Media Area activity files

Type.description: Activity type identifier — LABEL or TEXTMEDIAAREA (case-insensitive)

Name.description: Display name of the text and media area

Description.description: Short description shown on the course page

Format.description: Overall format of the content block

Content.description: Ordered list of content items (files to include)

Type.description: Content item type — currently only MARKDOWN is supported

ContentFilePath.description: Relative path to the content file (e.g. ./content/intro.md)
